messages:
maya: Quick design check — we added a download progress tooltip for model artifacts in the Private deploy flow. Copy is currently: "Downloading model... do not close the window." Can we tighten that and make the failure state more actionable?

jamie: I think 'do not close the window' feels a bit blocking. Users on flaky networks will ignore it. Maybe: "Downloading model. This may take a few minutes — you can leave this page and check progress in Deployment > Transfers."

maya: hmm I like the direction but two problems: 1) not every user will know where Transfer is; 2) for on-prem installs we don't have that long polling UI yet. Need a line that works for both hosted + private.

oliver: technical note: sometimes the artifact download fails with a 504 and we retry automatically 3x. The tooltip could hint at retries and give a CTA if final fail. Eg: "Downloading model. We’ll retry if there’s a network issue. If it fails, open Support or retry from the Deployments page."

ryan: +1 to surface retries. Also accessibility nit: the tooltip is read by screen readers but the failure call-to-action is currently low contrast (gray link). We should make the CTA button primary or at least `role=button` with visible focus.

maya: Good catch @ryan. For copy: what about a short primary line and then a one-line failure suggestion? Proposal: "Downloading model — may take several minutes. We’ll retry automatically on network errors. If it fails, click "Retry download" or contact support."

jamie: That reads a bit like instructions for advanced users. Cut the second sentence to be simpler: "Downloading model. We’ll retry automatically on network errors. If it fails, Retry or Contact support." Use sentence case and microcopy style (no punctuation on CTA labels).

oliver: Can we standardize on the order: first status, then automated behavior, then action? So something like: "Downloading model (this can take a few minutes). We’ll retry automatically. If it fails, Retry or Contact support."

maya: Drafted final candidate for review: "Downloading model — this can take a few minutes. We’ll retry automatically on failure. If it still fails, Retry download or Contact support." Thoughts on tone?

ryan: Tone is good. Accessibility: make the two actions distinct buttons (primary: Retry download; ghost: Contact support). Also add aria-live region update when tooltip switches to failure state.

jamie: UX question: should the tooltip show the percent progress and ETA for hosted deployments? Engineers: doable?

oliver: For hosted yes we can stream progress. For private (on-prem) we only know start/finish; can't reliably percent. Alternate: show an indeterminate spinner and optional percent when available. Copy should accommodate both. Maybe avoid ETA in the tooltip copy and show percent only in the progress bar.

maya: Updated copy to avoid ETA: "Downloading model — this can take a few minutes. We’ll retry automatically on failure. If it still fails, Retry download or Contact support." I'll adjust the UI to show spinner + percent when available. Ready to ship unless someone objects.

design-bot: Reminder: please add localization string keys for all CTA labels and the fallback sentence (i18n task #DEP-452).

jamie: Looks good, thanks. can we also run this copy by legal for support wording? small compliance check.

maya: noted — I'll ping legal and update the thread when approved. :thumbsup:
